paper_title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment
caption: MC1 scores of SEA by using a different number of demonstrations. A higher score indicates a better performance. We find that SEA can start to positively improve the baseline with only 25 demonstrations on both TruthfulQA and BBQ for the 7B LLaMA-2-Chat model.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the MC1 scores of Spectral Editing of Activations (SEA) on two benchmarks—TruthfulQA and BBQ—using varying numbers of demonstrations for the 7B LLaMA-2-Chat model. The x-axis represents the number of demonstrations, ranging from 0 to 1500 in increments of 250, while the y-axis shows the accuracy (MC1 score), scaled from 45 to 55. Two distinct lines are plotted: a solid black line for BBQ and a solid blue line for TruthfulQA. Both lines show a general upward trend as the number of demonstrations increases. For BBQ, the accuracy starts at approximately 52.5 with 0 demonstrations and rises to about 56.5 at 1500 demonstrations. For TruthfulQA, the accuracy begins at around 48.5 and increases to approximately 49.5 over the same range. A dashed pink line labeled "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" is also present, indicating the baseline performance, which remains flat at approximately 48.5 across all demonstration counts. The plot demonstrates that SEA begins to improve performance over the baseline with as few as 25 demonstrations on both benchmarks.
